reports.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
reports.title_zh: Claude记忆持久化插件
reports.summary: 为各类AI智能体提供跨会话的持久上下文：自动记录智能体在会话中的所有操作，用AI压缩后把相关上下文注入后续会话，支持Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode等。
reports.content: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

reports.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
reports.title_zh: OpenMausBot开源Grok机器人替代方案
reports.summary: 开源的Grok Bot替代项目，为机器人配备可自主操作的虚拟机环境，让智能体能够像人一样在虚拟桌面中执行任务。
reports.content: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use

reports.title: pbakaus/impeccable

reports.content: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.

reports.title: CopilotKit/OpenBot
reports.title_zh: OpenBot开源AI数字同事
reports.summary: 开源的AI数字同事项目，每个智能体都拥有独立的计算机环境（浏览器、文件和工具），所有动作先决策后执行并留痕记录，支持接入任意AG-UI智能体。
reports.content: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.

reports.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu

reports.content: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据

reports.content: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services

reports.title: macro-inc/macro
reports.title_zh: Macro一体化团队协作工作台

reports.content: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.

reports.title: mattpocock/skills

reports.content: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

reports.summary: pingdotgg团队推出的代码工具项目，面向TypeScript生态，探索AI辅助下的现代开发工作流。

reports.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
reports.title_zh: Claude Code 的 VS Code 扩展在 Cursor 插件市场被植入后门

reports.title: AI isn't replacing SREs, it's deskilling them
reports.title_zh: AI 并没有取代 SRE，而是在削弱他们的能力
reports.summary: 文章认为AI并未真正替代站点可靠性工程师，反而让工程师逐渐丧失深入排查与系统理解的核心技能，形成隐性风险。

reports.title: Northflank Breached
reports.title_zh: Northflank 遭到入侵
reports.summary: 云开发平台 Northflank 披露安全入侵事件，官方正在调查影响范围并通知受影响用户。

reports.title: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises
reports.title_zh: Azure 最薄弱的环节：五起完整的跨租户攻陷

reports.title: My favourite PowerMac is a Nintendo Wii
reports.title_zh: 我最爱的 PowerMac 其实是一台任天堂 Wii
reports.summary: 作者把一台任天堂 Wii 改装成运行经典 Mac 环境的机器，讲述这段充满折腾乐趣的复古硬件改造经历。

reports.title: The federated code forge
reports.title_zh: 联邦式代码托管平台

reports.title: Florilegium: Procedural Flowers in LaTeX

reports.title: Breaking the open web won't stop the bad bots
reports.title_zh: 打破开放网络并不能阻止恶意爬虫
reports.summary: 文章反驳以封锁开放网络来对抗恶意机器人的思路，指出这只会伤害正常用户与开放生态，而恶意爬虫依然能找到出路。

reports.title: Through Captain Jean-Luc Picard, Patrick Stewart taught us the measure of a man
reports.title_zh: 通过 Jean-Luc Picard 舰长，Patrick Stewart 教会我们人的尺度
reports.summary: 一篇关于《星际迷航》与 Patrick Stewart 表演的文章，讨论 Picard 舰长这一角色如何诠释人性与尊严的衡量标准。

reports.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3

reports.title: Sam Altman says it’s better for RAM to be in a data center than on your desk

reports.summary: OpenAI CEO 表示把内存资源集中到数据中心比留在个人设备上更划算，折射出AI算力与硬件资源分配的新思路。

reports.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

reports.summary: 谷歌把AI数据中心送上卫星，并成功完成首次与地面的推理响应传输，验证了太空算力的可行性。

reports.title: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’
reports.title_zh: 教皇利奥呼吁为AI“解除武装”：机器是工具，不是人
reports.summary: 教皇利奥公开呼吁对AI进行约束与“解除武装”，强调机器只是工具而非具备人格的主体。

reports.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web

reports.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity

reports.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom

reports.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch

reports.summary: Meta 低调推出一款名为 Style Sketch 的AI时尚应用，探索生成式AI在穿搭与造型场景中的落地。
